title: Tartare of Almond Crusted Fish
description: A delicate fish tartare coated with a crunchy almond crust, perfect for a light dinner.

ingredients.name: Nutty olive oil
ingredients.notes: Extra virgin olive oil with a nutty flavor

ingredients.name: Tartare sauce (store-bought or homemade)
ingredients.notes: Optional, but recommended for added flavor

instructions: 1. Rinse the cod under cold water, pat dry with paper towels.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together almond flour, bread crumbs, and a pinch of fix salt.
3. Coat the cod with the almond mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
4. Heat nutty olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
5. Add the coated cod to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
6. Remove the cod from the skillet and let it rest for 2 minutes.
7. Slice the cod into thin pieces and place on a plate.
8. Drizzle tartare sauce over the cod, if using.
9. Serve immediately, garnished with lemon wedges and fix salt to taste.
